summary.headline: Q4 FY26 standalone EBITDA was INR663 crore at 22.9% margin on record OHT volumes of 85,820 MT, while management flagged raw material inflation of 7-8% in Q1 FY27.
summary.overview: Balkrishna posted its highest-ever quarterly and annual OHT volumes, with Q4 volume up 5% YoY to 85,820 MT and FY26 volume at 317,356 MT. Standalone Q4 revenue rose 2% YoY to INR2,894 crore, but EBITDA margin was hit late in the quarter by geopolitical supply-chain headwinds, and FY26 EBITDA fell 10% YoY to INR2,423 crore. The company has stopped giving volume guidance, is starting its on-highway push (TBR, 2-wheeler, PCR), and has approved an additional INR2,000 crore capex. Management signalled raw material and margin pressure into FY27 with only partial price pass-through so far.

segments.name: Off-highway tyres (OHT)
segments.commentary: Q4 volume of 85,820 MT (+5% YoY) was a record; H2 clearly stronger than H1 with Europe recovering on easing channel inventories and Americas improving. US was just under 10% of FY26 volume, with a target of about 10% in FY27.

segments.name: Carbon black
segments.commentary: FY26 revenue grew marginally; third-party sales were about 9% of the business. Capacity is 265,000 MTPA after the December 2025 line, with the new lines fully utilised; about 30% of output is consumed internally and about 70% sold externally at industry-average margins.

segments.name: On-highway tyres (OHT-on-road)
segments.commentary: Entered truck-bus radial with launches in February 2026 and re-launched 2-wheeler tyres (capacity about 100,000 tyres a month). Phase 1 CV radial capex of INR750 crore added 800 tyres a day of fungible CVR/OHT capacity; PCR launch is targeted by end of calendar 2026 with first-phase capacity of 6,700 tyres a day. Long-term vision is INR5,000 crore revenue by 2030.

guidance_outlook: No volume guidance for FY27 given the geopolitical uncertainty; management expects growth but declined to quantify it.
Raw material prices rose about 4-5% in Q4 FY26 and are expected to rise a further 7-8% in the June 2026 quarter.
Price hikes of 3-5% already taken across geographies, with a further roughly 2% targeted by end of May 2026; more hikes possible.
Freight was about 4.5-5% of revenue in Q4 and is expected to rise marginally absent further disruption.
FY27 total capex guided at INR1,500-1,800 crore; maintenance capex about INR200 crore a year on top of projects.
Management aims to sustain EBITDA margins of 23-25% at company level even as on-highway scales up; 5-year revenue growth vision of about 17% CAGR, with the jump back-ended as capacity comes on line.
EUR/INR realization about INR99 in Q4; FY27 hedge rate expected to be higher than this year, not yet quantified.
Final dividend of INR4 per share recommended, on top of INR12 paid over the previous three quarters.
risks_watch: Raw material inflation of 7-8% in the June 2026 quarter, with only partial pass-through through price hikes; management flagged likely near-term margin pressure in FY27.
Geopolitical supply-chain disruption affecting freight (about 4.5-5% of revenue) and margins.
Execution risk on the on-highway ramp (TBR, PCR, 2-wheeler) with no disclosed revenue targets for FY27 and PCR launch slated for end-2026.
Funding of the INR3,800 crore remaining capex is not finalised; the possible peak debt level was not confirmed (gross debt INR4,049 crore at March 2026).
Realisation of the US reciprocal tariff refund and how much will be passed to distributors.
Balance carbon black capacity (to 360,000 MTPA) and CV Phase 2 are due in Q1 FY27 and during FY27; any slippage would affect the ramp.
summary.management_tone: Confident on long-term vision and on the H2 recovery, but cautious and at times evasive on FY27: volume guidance was withheld, and funding, margin and hedge-rate questions drew "too volatile" or "can't assume anything" type answers.
key_quotes: So we stopped giving guidance due to the geopolitical scenarios and uncertainties.
At this moment, we may have some price pressures, margin pressures.
This was our highest ever quarter and best number.
We have positioned ourselves as a premium player in that category.

Margin impacted late in quarter by geopolitical supply-chain headwinds
Flattish YoY; includes realized forex loss of INR164 crore
Gross debt INR4,049 crore; cash and equivalents INR3,154 crore

qa_highlights.question: Volume guidance for OHT in FY27 and CV radial sales expectations?
qa_highlights.answer: Management stopped volume guidance due to geopolitical uncertainty; expects growth but will not quantify. CV radial business has just begun, with the 2030 vision still the target.

qa_highlights.question: Total FY27 capex and the INR2,000 crore additional capex: what it covers and whether it is incremental to the INR6,800 crore plan?
qa_highlights.answer: FY27 capex guided at INR1,500-1,800 crore. The INR2,000 crore covers capacity expansion, infrastructure, AI automation and sustainability, staggered over several years. INR6,800 crore includes about INR3,000 crore already spent; maintenance capex about INR200 crore a year is extra.

qa_highlights.question: Raw material and price pass-through outlook; near-term margin pressure in FY27?
qa_highlights.answer: Raw material rose about 4-5% in Q4 and may rise 7-8% in June quarter. Price hikes of 3-5% taken with about 2% more by end-May. Management said 'we may have some price pressures, margin pressures' and is evaluating pass-through.

qa_highlights.question: Can company EBITDA margin of 23-25% be sustained with on-highway scale-up?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said the company as a whole aims to keep sustained EBITDA levels, which it is maintaining; the 23-25% range is the endeavour, applied at company level rather than by segment.

qa_highlights.question: Peak debt and funding of remaining capex?
qa_highlights.answer: Funding is a mix of sources and not yet finalised. Management said 'We can't assume anything. It's a volatile world' when asked if INR4,000 crore of gross debt is the peak.

qa_highlights.question: US reciprocal tariff refund: filed, and how much passes to distributors?
qa_highlights.answer: The company is importer on record and has filed; nothing received yet and quantum not disclosed. Management said it would be fair practice to pass back part of any amount recovered from customers.
